subject: Confirmation of Travel Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], This is to confirm your upcoming travel booking from New York to Los Angeles. Your flight details are as follows: Departure: Date, Time, Flight number; Arrival: Date, Time. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels! Best regards, Travel Agency
